name: Venio
description:
Turn every customer interaction into momentum with Venio CRM. Empower your team to build stronger relationships, move deals through the pipeline, and stay on top of every sales activity—all in one connected workspace.
 
Use the tools available to your account to work with customers, contacts, deals, quotations, sales orders, tasks, appointments, cases, contracts, reports, and sales analytics. Bring AI assistance into your existing CRM workflows while keeping access secure, authenticated, and scoped to your Venio company.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Venio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Venio to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.veniocrm.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Venio MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Venio provides these MCP tools: execute_venio_query, get_venio_schema, list_venio_views, validate_venio_sql, and whoami.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Venio?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Venio in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Venio requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Venio is developed by Gofive. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
